name: Chikan Kyoushi ~Nerawareta Mesu Seito~
original_name: 痴漢教師～狙われた牝生徒～
source:
His targets are schoolgirl-age daughters of nobility!
Three pupils are being stalked by the protagonist, a teacher who's got a hard desire for certain girls. He'll pound the full spectrum of sex education directly into their bodies!!

- Molest everywhere from the trains to the classrooms!
- Fondle girls as their bodies sway to the motions of the train!!
- Seize virginity in the name of student leadership!!
- Coerce sex by exploiting personal information!
Be the teacher, and drill your students as much as you please!
